params.caption: 🖥️ US moves to close the cloud loophole on AI GPU export bans The US Bureau of Industry and Security has announced a new interim final rule targeting remote access to AI servers. The aim is to stop Chinese firms from getting around the export restrictions on physical AI hardware by renting that compute in data centers around the world. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 00:50 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 💬 Will this ripple into GPU prices?
